ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: <image>In $\triangle P Q R, R S=3$ and $Q S=14 .$ Find $P S$
ready1_open_rewrite.title: Geometry3K open-ended problem

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The image shows: In triangle PQR, there is a right-angle mark at point P, indicating that ∠RPQ is a right angle; S is located on side RQ, and a line segment PS is drawn from P to S, and there is also a right-angle mark at point S, indicating that PS is perpendicular to RQ. Therefore, PS is the altitude drawn from the right-angle vertex P to the hypotenuse RQ of the right triangle. Given RS=3, QS=14. According to the altitude theorem on the hypotenuse of a right triangle, PS^2 = RS · QS = 3 · 14 = 42, so PS = √42.

method.method_draft: First read the diagram: R, S, Q are collinear with S between R and Q; PS is perpendicular to RQ; and angle RPQ is marked right. From the text, RS=3 and QS=14, so RQ=17. Set up coordinates with R=(0,0), S=(3,0), and Q=(17,0). Because PS is perpendicular to RQ, let P=(3,h), where h=PS. The right angle at P means vectors PR and PQ are perpendicular, so their dot product is 0: R-P=(-3,-h), Q-P=(14,-h), and (-3)(14)+(-h)(-h)=0. Hence -42+h^2=0, so h=sqrt(42).
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中三角形标为 \(\triangle PQR\)，点 \(P\) 在左上，点 \(R\) 在左下，点 \(Q\) 在右上。线段 \(RQ\) 是一条斜边，点 \(S\) 位于 \(R\) 与 \(Q\) 之间，所以 \(R,S,Q\) 共线。图中在 \(P\) 处有直角标记，表示 \(\angle RPQ=90^\circ\)；在 \(S\) 处也有直角标记，表示 \(PS\perp RQ\)。
再推理：已知 \(RS=3\)，\(QS=14\)，所以 \(RQ=3+14=17\)。按指定方法设坐标：令 \(R=(0,0)\)，\(S=(3,0)\)，\(Q=(17,0)\)。因为 \(PS\perp RQ\)，所以点 \(P\) 在经过 \(S\) 的垂线上，可设 \(P=(3,h)\)，其中 \(h=PS\)。又因为 \(\angle RPQ\) 是直角，所以向量 \(\overrightarrow{PR}\) 与 \(\overrightarrow{PQ}\) 垂直。计算从 \(P\) 指向 \(R\) 和 \(Q\) 的向量：\(R-P=(-3,-h)\)，\(Q-P=(14,-h)\)。垂直则点积为 0：\((-3)(14)+(-h)(-h)=0\)，即 \(-42+h^2=0\)。因此 \(h^2=42\)，且长度为正，所以 \(PS=h=\sqrt{42}\)。
